- **BMI Requirement (≥35):** MET – Patient BMI 35.0 kg/m² documented 6/19/2025 (doc-002)

- **Obesity-Related Comorbidities:** MET – Type 2 diabetes mellitus (active since 10/30/2016) and essential hypertension (active, clinic-followed as of 2025) documented (cond-009, doc-003)

- **Prior Weight Management Program:** MET – Completed 6-month physician-supervised program with dietitian and phentermine trial; net loss 2 kg with regain after discontinuation, documented as unsuccessful (doc-004)

- **Covered Procedure Type:** **NOT MET** – Intragastric balloon placement (CPT 43290) is not a covered bariatric procedure under this plan.

**Next Steps:**

Please contact our plan to discuss covered bariatric procedure options that may be appropriate for this patient.
